//.compile: Ahead of time with Bun canary (docs/AOT.md): mise run compile, or BUN_CANARY=<path to canary bun> bun run compile.
//.compile:jit: Bun 1.4.4 with the flags docs/RUNTIME.md measured best, bytecode laid out by --version and serve profiles (scripts/compile-jit.sh).
//.dependencies: None beyond the workspace and Effect's Bun platform layers.
//.package: slopmax-<target>.tar.gz (binary at the root) and its .sha256, as install.sh and the release workflow name them (DIST-008/009); a Linux target names the libc dist/slopmax links (gnu or musl).
//.compile:musl: The JIT build for musl Linux (Alpine, and the `unknown-linux-musl` release assets): Bun's musl runtime needs musl's loader and libstdc++, so it runs on musl systems only.
//.budget: DIST-004: at most 8 third-party packages in the dependency tree and a dist/slopmax of at most 73,400,320 bytes (scripts/budget.ts; mise run budget).
